issue.title: [Bug] test_retry_count.py failure in KVM CI due to PORT_PHY_ATTR ERR logs

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

VS/KVM

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

`tests/pc/test_retry_count.py::test_retry_count` is failing in KVM CI test runs. The failure is triggered by ERR-level syslog messages from orchagent's new PORT_PHY_ATTR flex counter feature (sonic-swss#3957, sonic-swss#4017):

```
ERR swss#orchagent: :- verifyPortSupportsAllPhyAttr: PORT_PHY_ATTR: Port Ethernet0 does not support RX_SIGNAL_DETECT attribute (status=-15)
ERR swss#orchagent: :- verifyPortSupportsAllPhyAttr: PORT_PHY_ATTR: Port Ethernet1 does not support RX_SIGNAL_DETECT attribute (status=-15)
```

The VS SAI doesn't implement PHY attributes (`RX_SIGNAL_DETECT`, `FEC_ALIGNMENT_LOCK`, `RX_SNR`), so every port triggers this ERR log. The log analyzer picks these up as unexpected errors, causing test failures.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run `tests/pc/test_retry_count.py` on a VS/KVM testbed after sonic-swss submodule includes #3957/#4017.

### Elastictest Reference

- Test plan: https://elastictest.org/scheduler/testplan/6997eef5184b36a9b4fb45b6?testcase=pc%2Ftest_retry_count.py%7C%7C%7C2&type=console
- PR triggering the failure: sonic-net/sonic-buildimage#25552 (unrelated change — build hooks fix)

### Related Issues

- sonic-net/sonic-swss#4242 — Root cause: orchagent logs ERR for unsupported PHY attributes on VS
- #19400 — Pre-existing test_retry_count setup fixture issue (may be related or compounding)

### Suggested Fix

Short-term: Add `verifyPortSupportsAllPhyAttr` ERR messages to the log analyzer's expected errors list for VS/KVM platforms.

Long-term: Fix in sonic-swss to downgrade the log level from ERR to WARNING/INFO when SAI returns `SAI_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED` (tracked in sonic-swss#4242).

resolution.title: [loganalyzer] Ignore PORT_PHY_ATTR ERR on VS/KVM platforms (fixes #22510)
resolution.description:
## What
Add `verifyPortSupportsAllPhyAttr` ERR pattern to `loganalyzer_common_ignore.txt`.

## Why
VS SAI does not implement PHY attributes (`RX_SIGNAL_DETECT`, `FEC_ALIGNMENT_LOCK`, `RX_SNR`), so orchagent logs ERR for every port after sonic-swss#3957/#4017. The log analyzer picks these up as unexpected errors, causing test failures (e.g., `test_retry_count`).

## How
Single regex in the common ignore list:
```
r, ".*ERR swss#orchagent.*verifyPortSupportsAllPhyAttr.*PORT_PHY_ATTR.*does not support.*attribute.*"
```

## Long-term fix
Tracked in sonic-net/sonic-swss#4242 — downgrade the log level from ERR to WARNING/INFO when SAI returns `SAI_STATUS_NOT_SUPPORTED`.

Fixes #22510
